intro: Foreman Thazz'ril accidentally left his favorite enchanted mining pick deep inside the northern cavern during a mineral survey. Now overrun by dangerous beasts, the cave known as the Burning Blade Coven holds the glowing tool awaiting recovery.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you are a dependable traveler. Can I count on you for another task?

Some time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind. When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts! Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?
I left it in a chamber with waterfalls. My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... Just what's guarding it!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, friend? Did you find my pick?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, you got it! Thanks a lot, friend. This is my favorite pick! Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!
